text:
Type: Persian rug with a central medallion
Use: warming a floor area, accent beside a bed or sofa; living room, bedroom, entryway, study
Style: traditional, classic, bohemian
Materials: hand-knotted wool in a short dense pile
Colors: deep brick red, navy blue, rust orange, cream and olive accents
Shape: rectangle with a central diamond medallion, dense geometric motifs, repeating border bands, flat and low
Feel: rich, warm, heritage, cozy
Goes with: dark wood, leather, brass accents, warm neutrals; traditional, bohemian or eclectic rooms

product.name: PERSISK HAMADAN
product.description: Hand-knotted by skilled craftspeople, and therefore unique in design and size.
